hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd /Users/benrosen/march-madness-forecaster && ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null && ruff format --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force(\s|$)|git\s+reset\s+--hard)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command blocked. Use a safer alternative or get explicit approval."}}'; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.secret|credentials|api_key)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Writing to secrets/credentials files is blocked. Store secrets in environment variables."}}'; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE 'MEMORY\.md$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"MEMORY.md is protected. Edit it manually with explicit intent."}}'; fi; } || true
